name: kernel_status
description: Metadata for the current immutable Plan2001 kernel source snapshot.

name: kernel_pop
description: Select the current snapshot for reading; non-destructive.

name: kernel_history
description: List published source sessions newest first, including failed and incomplete sessions, with snapshot IDs and hashes.

name: kernel_list
description: List indexed files and virtual directories by path prefix and stable cursor.

name: kernel_read
description: Read bounded bytes or lines from one indexed source file. Offsets are bytes.

name: kernel_search
description: Search indexed filenames or source text for a literal query.

name: kernel_manifest
description: Return a stable page of the complete indexed file manifest.

name: kernel_archive_chunk
description: Read a bounded base64 chunk of the complete deterministic source archive.

name: task_submit
description: Store a bounded text task for OpenCode; the host never executes task content. OAuth clients do not provide a write key.

write_key.description: Legacy OpenCode credential; omit when using OAuth.

name: task_claim
description: Claim the next queued OpenCode task. Active leases do not expire; cancel a stuck task with task_cancel.

worker_key.description: Legacy OpenCode credential; omit when using OAuth.

lease_seconds.description: Legacy compatibility only; ignored because task leases have no time limit.

name: task_report
description: Report a completed, failed, or cancelled task and its test results.

worker_key.description: Legacy OpenCode credential; omit when using OAuth.

worker_agent.description: Worker label for the completion notice; optional and backward compatible.

name: task_status
description: Read task status without exposing its instructions or credentials. OAuth clients do not provide a read key.

read_key.description: Legacy OpenCode credential; omit when using OAuth.

name: task_cancel
description: Cancel one pending or leased task. For a leased task, requests worker termination; the single worker acknowledges cancellation before another task can be claimed.

worker_key.description: Legacy OpenCode credential; omit when using OAuth.

name: task_clear
description: Cancel every pending task and request cancellation of the active leased task. Terminal history is retained. Requires confirm exactly CLEAR_ALL_TASKS. Submit a new task separately with task_submit.

write_key.description: Legacy OpenCode credential; omit when using OAuth.

name: task_queue_status
description: List pending and leased tasks, including cancellation requests, without exposing task instructions or lease tokens. Active worker leases do not expire.

read_key.description: Legacy read credential; omit when using OAuth.
